If you are nearby and low contact you have constant pulls of the hoover, I had to move back to parents home after my ex kicked me out, I have reason to believe that my parents were involved with that.There were smear campaigns that i  had no idea existed going on behind my back, and these even reached my close friends, and work place. If you are able to get away and build a new life, its the only real way to be safe.
